newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-SPAIN HIT BY INJURIES AHEAD OF YUGOSLAVIA QUALIFIER.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SPAIN HIT BY INJURIES AHEAD OF YUGOSLAVIA QUALIFIER.

text.p: Spain have an injury crisis in midfield ahead of Saturday's World Cup qualifier against Yugoslavia.
With influential Atletico Madrid playmaker Jose Luis Caminero already out, Spanish manager Javier Clemente is now faced with losing Real Madrid's Fernando Hierro and Athletic Bilbao's Julen Guerrero.

Hierro, an instant first choice for the national side for the past six years, limped off in Saturday's big game against Barcelona. Guerrero has not resumed training because of a leg wound caused by Atletico's Diego Simeone which needed four stitches.

The injuries could open the way for newly-capped Betis big man Roberto Rios, who scored twice over the weekend. Deportivo's Armando Alvarez was unexpectedly called up to replace Caminero last week and could yet make his debut.
